title: Trust by Design: Trust Calibration Through Non-Advisory Socratic Dialogue in Conversational Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.14818v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As conversational AI systems increasingly operate in sensitive domains, the central challenge shifts from usability to trust calibration, ensuring that users rely on systems neither too much nor too little. Systems that provide advice or interpretations risk encouraging inappropriate reliance, particularly when users perceive AI outputs as authoritative. We present CASELy, a conversational agent explicitly designed to limit its own authority through non-advisory Socratic dialogue. The agent asks reflective questions grounded exclusively in user input and refuses to provide advice, recommendations, or interpretations. This design operationalizes trust calibration by constraining agent agency rather than optimizing capability. translated_title: 设计即信任：通过对话智能体中的非建议式苏格拉底对话实现信任校准
translated_abstract: 随着对话式AI系统日益在敏感领域运行，核心挑战已从可用性转向信任校准，即确保用户对系统的依赖既不过度也不不足。提供建议或解释的系统存在助长不当依赖的风险，尤其当用户将AI输出视为权威时。我们提出了CASELy，一个通过非建议式苏格拉底对话明确限制自身权威的对话智能体。该智能体仅基于用户输入提出反思性问题，并拒绝提供建议、推荐或解释。这一设计通过约束智能体的自主性而非优化其能力来实现信任校准。在一项针对高等教育学生的初步随机对照研究中，与苏格拉底对话交互的参与者报告了显著更高的用户体验（UEQ-S整体得分=1.50），优于非对话……
tldr: 本文提出CASELy对话智能体，通过非建议式苏格拉底对话（仅提出基于用户输入的反思性问题、拒绝提供任何建议或解释）来限制自身权威，从而实现用户信任校准，初步随机对照实验显示该方法带来了更高的用户体验。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CASELy, a conversational agent that achieves trust calibration by constraining its own authority through non-advisory Socratic dialogue—asking only reflective questions grounded in user input while refusing to give advice—demonstrating higher user experience in a pilot randomized controlled study.
